description: NaCdSbS₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CdS₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with four CdS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-22°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.05 Å. There are two inequivalent Cd sites. In the first Cd site, Cd is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted CdS₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent CdS₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent CdS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.59-3.15 Å. In the second Cd site, Cd is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted CdS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent CdS₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent CdS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-22°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.61-3.16 Å. Sb is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three S atoms. There are two shorter (2.48 Å) and one longer (2.50 Å) Sb-S bond length. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to one Na, four Cd, and one Sb atom to form distorted SNaCd₄Sb octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SNaCd₄Sb octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₃CdSb square pyramids, edges with four equivalent SNaCd₄Sb octahedra, and edges with three equivalent SNa₃CdSb square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-12°. In the second S site, S is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cd, and one Sb atom. In the third S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na, one Cd, and one Sb atom to form SNa₃CdSb square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNaCd₄Sb octahedra, corners with three equivalent SNa₃CdSb square pyramids, edges with three equivalent SNaCd₄Sb octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SNa₃CdSb square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-85°.
